description: This file defines a serializer class for savings account transaction business events, converting them into Avro data transfer objects (DTOs) suitable for serialization. It implements the BusinessEventSerializer interface and uses dependencies such as a savings account read platform service and a data mapper.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransactionBusinessEventSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class that converts savings account transaction business events into Avro DTOs for serialization.

methods.name: canSerialize
methods.description: Checks if the given business event can be serialized by this serializer, specifically whether it is an instance of SavingsAccountTransactionBusinessEvent.

methods.name: toAvroDTO
methods.description: Converts a SavingsAccountTransactionBusinessEvent into an Avro DTO by retrieving transaction data and mapping it to the Avro schema.

methods.name: getSupportedSchema
methods.description: Returns the class of the Avro schema supported, in this case SavingsAccountTransactionDataV1.
